notes: #7: the Swiss National Library dates it only ‘before 1840’; it sits in Commons’ Speyer in the 1830s category and shows a Rhine steamer, so labeled 1830s. #16: the archive dates Knippenberg’s photos only to 1931–43, hence the range label. #9 is credited to Photoglob Zürich (print no. 8351, the ‘P.Z.’ prefix); #14 and #19 are copies of the same photochrom. #2–#6 are other copies of the same Braun and Hogenberg plate (Heidelberg, Speyer, Worms); #4 is a larger colored copy (strip about 5,500 px wide) if more resolution is wanted. #15 (Mittelholzer) skipped: its film is noted as misfiled, so the date is unsure. P6 alternative showing the cathedral itself: #22 (2023, sunset, but museum roofs in the foreground). #12 (1854) and #13 (1872) are good engravings of the cathedral alone, too close in date to the chosen views.
